requirements.title: IEEE_LOGB zero result and divide-by-zero flag
requirements.definition: For X equal to zero, IEEE_LOGB returns negative infinity on processors supporting infinity for X and -HUGE(X) otherwise; IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO signals.

pending.IEEE_LOGB-zero-negative-infinity-when-su: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) for IEEE_LOGB, IEEE_VALUE, and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE, plus I = IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0). Branch D true and I true: evaluate IEEE_LOGB(+0.0), assert the result equals -IEEE_VALUE(0.0, IEEE_POSITIVE_INF), and assert IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(result) is true; all other branches skip this assertion.
pending.IEEE_LOGB-zero-negative-huge-without-inf: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and I = IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0). Branch D true and I false: evaluate IEEE_LOGB(+0.0) and assert the result equals -HUGE(0.0); all other branches skip this assertion.
pending.IEEE_LOGB-zero-signals-divide-by-zero: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), F = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, 0.0) for IEEE_SET_FLAG, IEEE_GET_FLAG, and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, and H = IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO) for IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE. Branch D true, F true, H true: set divide-by-zero halting false, clear IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, evaluate IEEE_LOGB(+0.0), and assert IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO true; branch D true, F true, H false with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE reporting h false: clear IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, evaluate IEEE_LOGB(+0.0), and assert IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO true; branch D true, F true, H false with h true: skip; unsupported branches skip.

The embedded Note restates the finite exponent relation and is not a separate normative requirement.

review_rationale: Source registration for 17.11.16-17.11.21: IEEE_LOGB, IEEE_MAX, IEEE_MAX_MAG, IEEE_MAX_NUM, IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG and IEEE_MIN (batch217). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; each MAX/MIN variant is discriminated from its neighbours by a planned row, NaN handling covers quiet and signaling operands, and exception rows are halting-safe. Source accounting only.
